_register: Buttons, menu entries and step lists use the imperative (2nd person singular: Posudi, Spremi, Skeniraj crtični kod), as Croatian software does; sentences addressed to the reader are impersonal where possible, otherwise formal « vi » in lower case (vaš, vašu, never ti); no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Croatian low-high quotes „text“ (U+201E opening, U+201C closing), no inner spaces; nested quotes use » « ; the arrow → stays. Dates are written « 1. 11. 2026. » (a space after each full stop, a final full stop), the decimal separator is a comma, the thousands separator a space or a full stop, and a space precedes % and units (« 10 % »). Names of things inserted by placeholder ({{title}}, {{name}}) cannot be declined, so write sentences where the inserted text stays in the nominative after a colon or inside quotes (« Posuđeno: „{{title}}“ »).
_plural: Croatian has three plural forms: one (1, 21, 31 … but not 11), few (2–4, 22–24 … but not 12–14), other (0, 5–20, 25–30 …); give all three, e.g. {{count}} {{count:plural; one:učenik; few:učenika; other:učenika;}} — note that the genitive plural is needed after 5 and more, and that « few » takes the genitive singular for most masculine and feminine nouns (2 knjige, 5 knjiga).

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; never « kopija ».

record.note: The catalogue entry of a title, as in Croatian library cataloguing; in short labels « zapis » alone is fine.

patron.note: Usual word in Croatian libraries (« korisnici knjižnice »); « član » is used for the holder of a card but « korisnik » is the one word for a student or teacher who borrows. Feminine « korisnica » is not used; the plain masculine is generic.

card.note: Short form « iskaznica » where the context is clear.

loan.note: Verb « posuditi » (lend: « posuditi knjigu korisniku »); « izdavanje » and « zaduživanje » are also heard in school libraries, but « posudba » is the standard library term.

return.note: The action: « Povrat » on the menu; verb « vratiti » or « evidentirati povrat ».

renew.note: Extending the due date (« produljenje posudbe »); « obnova » is not used here because it is close to « restore » (vraćanje podataka). Keep « produlj- » everywhere.

due date.note: Short form of « rok za povrat »; « datum povrata » is also correct but « rok » is shorter on buttons.

overdue.note: As an adjective in a list: « u kašnjenju »; as a statement about a copy: « rok je prekoračen ».

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; the standard word in Croatian libraries for an overdue notice, « podsjetnik » is milder and not used.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS); « signatura » is the term of Croatian library science, never « oznaka ».

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and signatura on the spine; « hrbat » is the spine of a book.

label.note: An adhesive label with a barcode; « etiketa » is not used.

barcode.note: The term of Croatian library software and standards (HRN); « barkod » is the colloquial form and is not used in the interface. Plural « crtični kodovi ».

class.note: A school class (3. B); the class label stays as the school writes it.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for.

classification.note: The sorting scheme (UDK, the universal decimal classification, for non-fiction).

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; « revizija knjižnične građe » is the legal term in Croatian libraries; « inventura » is used for the accounting stocktake and « inventarizacija » for entering items in the inventory book, so neither is used here.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « prijedlozi za nabavu » is the librarian's phrase, but « popis želja » is plainer for a menu entry.

census.note: Registering the patrons with their photo; « popis » alone would be read as a list, so the activity is named explicitly. Menu entry: « Fotografije korisnika ».

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year.

anonymise.note: Erase the personal data of a patron for good; noun « anonimizacija ».

staff account.note: A shared login per role; « korisnički račun » is not used so that « korisnik » stays the patron.

restore.note: Verb « vratiti » (a copy of the data): « Vrati iz sigurnosne kopije »; « obnova » is avoided, see renew.

colour set.note: A palette of the interface; written « boja ».

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « skener » is the loanword and may be used in running text (verb « skenirati »).

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with; « demo podaci » is not used.

student.note: Generic masculine, with feminine « učenica » only where the gender is known.

teacher.note: In Croatian, « učitelj » is the teacher of grades 1–8 and « nastavnik » of secondary schools and of subject teaching; « nastavnik » is chosen as the one word that fits both (« nastavnici » in the menu). Feminine « nastavnica » only where the gender is known.

administration.note: Menu entry for the settings area; « upravljanje » is not used.

configuration.note: Always plural; the noun « konfiguracija » only in technical documents.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Posudba ».
